{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.72

|gr1= Math - Vectors
|gr2= Render Time Scope

|descr= Converts vector from model to world space in render time scope.
{{Feature|important|For [[setObjectScale|scaled objects]], the resulting vector's [[vectorMagnitude|magnitude]] will also be [[vectorMultiply|multiplied]] by the object scale.}}

|s1= object [[vectorModelToWorldVisual]] modelDir

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|p2= modelDir: [[Vector3D]] - vector direction in model space in format [x,y,z]

|r1= [[Vector3D]] - vector direction in world space in format [x,y,z]

|x1= Convert model space vector [0,-10,4] to world space; vector gets rotated according to _airplane: 
<sqf>_airplane vectorModelToWorldVisual [0,-10,4];</sqf>

|seealso= [[vectorDirVisual]] [[modelToWorldVisual]] [[addForce]] [[addTorque]] [[vectorModelToWorld]] [[vectorWorldToModel]] [[vectorWorldToModelVisual]]
}}
